title: Prestige Frontend
shortDescription: A fully responsive landing page for a fictional SaaS product called Prestige, built with React and Tailwind CSS.
fullDescription: Prestige is a modern, high-converting SaaS product landing page designed to showcase digital product features with fluid micro-interactions, responsive layouts, feature breakdowns, and interactive pricing tiers. Built with React and Tailwind CSS for a premium design aesthetic.
challenges: Crafting complex responsive grid layouts and gradient cards while adhering to high UI/UX accessibility standards.
Ensuring ultra-fast first contentful paint (FCP) and smooth micro-animations across all mobile viewports.
Designing modular UI components to make landing page sections easily reconfigurable.
futurePlans: Build an interactive live product sandbox preview within the hero section.
Add dark/light mode theme toggle capability with system preference auto-detection.
Integrate animated testimonial carousels and interactive ROI pricing calculators.
